confidence_note: Checked against book text (To Be or To Do). Old text replaced: the "What am I doing / what do I want to be" two-question framing and the claim about career crises are not in the book; the real scene is Boyd's fork-in-the-road speech.
facts: John Boyd: fighter pilot, lead instructor at Fighter Weapons School, Nellis AFB, "Forty-Second Boyd" (beat any opponent in under 40 seconds), later Pentagon.
No books, one academic paper, never above colonel after nearly thirty years; F-15 and F-16 were his pet projects; retired with small apartment and pension.
1973: Boyd called a protege to a meeting and gave a speech he repeated for years: "Tiger, one day you will come to a fork in the road."

Be somebody: compromises, turn your back on friends, join the club, promotions and good assignments. Do something: may not be promoted, not favored by superiors, but you do not compromise yourself and your work might make a difference. "To be or to do? Which way will you go?"
Chalkboard: DUTY, HONOR, COUNTRY crossed out and replaced with PRIDE, POWER, GREED.
Known as the ghetto colonel for frugal life; died with a drawerful of uncashed expense checks from private contractors, which he equated with bribes.
tension: Boyd chose the road without promotion, and paid for it.
opening_idea: Open on the 40-second nickname, the checks or the speech.

lessons.idea: Weigh an offer by the work it would let you do.
lessons.anchor: Boyd's fork: be somebody or do something.
lessons.everyday_example_idea: An accountant offered a manager title writes down the work she wants to do and reads the offer against it.

reflect_final: If the title or recognition you are chasing this year disappeared tomorrow, which piece of work would you keep doing anyway?

use_cases.move: Ask whether it brings you closer to the work or only to a title.

use_cases.situation: Yearly goals talk with a manager.
use_cases.move: Ask what work you want to be known for next year.

use_cases.situation: A job nobody will praise is waiting.

pocket_idea: Put Boyd's question to your next offer.

conversation_variants.punchline_idea: Boyd told young officers they would reach a fork where they could be somebody or do something.
conversation_variants.thirty_sec_idea: In 1973 Boyd laid two roads before a young officer: promotions at the price of compromises, or doing something without them. He never passed colonel. Holiday: ego blurs the choice.
